u0: Starting phase: the exit has not been reached and no switch toggle has been made yet. If the siren stays silent, make for the exit; stepping onto it while silent completes the task. If the siren rings before a toggle, go to the wall switch and toggle it from the facing cell rather than trying to finish. Toggling proactively, before a ring, is also valid and moves to the post-toggle phase with the small toggle reward. Holding or losing the box does not affect this objective.
u1: Siren-response phase: the siren is ringing and no switch toggle has happened yet. The immediate objective is to reach the wall switch, face it from the adjacent floor cell, and toggle it; that satisfies the switch condition, moves to the post-toggle phase, and collects the toggle reward. Reaching the exit while still in this unhandled-ring phase is not final success, so handle the switch first. The box is irrelevant to this phase.
u2: Post-toggle phase: at least one switch toggle has already been made, whether to silence a ring or proactively, so the switch part is complete and its small reward has been earned. The only remaining objective is to reach the exit; stepping onto the exit cell enters terminal success and grants the exit reward. No further toggle is required by the reward machine, even if the siren rings again, and box possession or loss does not change the goal.
u3: Terminal success phase: the exit has been reached validly, either while the siren was silent with no toggle, or after at least one switch toggle. The episode is complete and the exit reward has been collected; no further movement, toggling, or box handling is needed.
